selection: highest validation within25, then lowest median, then mean; L7 baseline eligible
gate: within25 +.5pp and median <=1.02 baseline, or median improves >=10% with within25 no worse by >.5pp
test_caveat: Repeated benchmark already inspected for L6/L7; exploratory follow-up, not fresh confirmation
coordinate_method: Spherical average only inside the highest-mass 25-km neighbor mode; k1 returns a training-photo coordinate
